feed.title: Banks scramble to control third-party AI agents inside customer accounts
feed.sum: Morgan Stanley and Bank of America are among banks trying to tell whether an agent's action is really what the customer asked for.
feed.why: Who approved this action? is now a bank-level problem. CUEPA's human-in-the-middle answer fits small businesses too.

feed.title: Outside testers found ways around OpenAI's monitor for its own AI agents
feed.sum: METR and Redwood spent three weeks inside OpenAI. Their 61-page report lists six evasion paths; OpenAI says it patched the findings that affected production.
feed.why: Even the biggest lab needed outsiders to check its agent watchdog. Protect, Challenge, Verify in real life.

feed.title: China-linked hackers used an AI agent system in the ConnectWise breach
feed.sum: Microsoft says Storm-0940 ran 2,900 password attempts a minute against 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants using the ARTEX framework.
feed.why: Small businesses run on tools like ConnectWise. A plain-language security post earns trust.

feed.title: Microsoft's diagnostic AI got 83% of hard cases right versus 36% for doctors alone
feed.sum: Published in Science. Clinical testing at Beth Israel Deaconess is set to start within two months. TechCrunch notes much of the gain may come from the underlying models.

feed.title: Reuters counts about 102,800 AI-linked layoffs across 31 companies in a year
feed.sum: HSBC (20,000) and Amazon (16,000) make up 35%; seven banks account for about 39%.
feed.why: Job seekers are anxious about AI cuts. Elipan Hires can be the calm, practical voice.

feed.title: Uber rolls ChatGPT out to 30,000+ employees after a 1,000-person pilot
feed.sum: Connected to Google Drive and Slack.
feed.why: Company-wide AI rollouts are a buying signal. Track who pilots, then scales.

feed.title: Volkswagen puts Microsoft Copilot in front of 330,000 staff
feed.sum: Over 300,000 use it monthly, and 26,000 agents went live in the past month.

feed.title: Claude makes auto mode the default for paid plans starting next week
feed.sum: Automated checks block risky actions, and users can switch back to approving each step.
feed.why: A good beginner explainer: what auto mode does, and how to keep approving things yourself.

feed.title: 1Password launches 1Password for Agents and passes $500M in yearly revenue
feed.sum: Built with Anthropic and OpenAI. The company says agent usage is up 500% year over year.
feed.why: Agents need keys. Who holds them, and who approves their use, is the CUEPA question.

feed.title: Anthropic used Claude to formally verify security in 123 open-source libraries
feed.sum: It found bugs that had gone unnoticed for years.

feed.title: Agent Skills, Open Responses, OpenEnv and OpenSandbox join the Agentic AI Foundation
feed.sum: Anthropic's Agent Skills alone counts 280 million installs since December 2025.

feed.title: Canva releases its first image-generation model to all users
feed.sum: Pitched as a cheaper, more customizable option inside Canva.
feed.why: Free, beginner-friendly and already in an app people use. Worth trying, not hyping.

feed.title: Ideogram's first vector model turns text prompts into editable SVGs
feed.sum: It can also convert existing images into vectors, with type and gradients.

feed.title: HeyGen launches Video 1, its first general-purpose video model
feed.sum: It ranked first for text-to-video in a blind Artificial Analysis test.

feed.title: OpenAI nears an up-to-$30B round at a $1.25 trillion valuation
feed.sum: Led by UAE investors and Coatue. That's down from the $1.4 trillion it pitched earlier this month.

feed.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises about $15B led by Tencent and CATL
feed.sum: Two days after a US order to remove DeepSeek tech from federal agencies.

feed.title: US Treasury proposes limits on outbound AI investment
feed.sum: Covers US investments over $50,000 in China, Russia, North Korea, Iran and Cuba in AI, supercomputing and biotech.

feed.title: WSJ: OpenAI fired three safety researchers over Signal chats
feed.sum: OpenAI calls it a breach of trust; the researchers dispute that account.

feed.title: Arc browser shuts down December 22 as its maker focuses on the AI browser Dia
Study: plain retrieval beat agent memory systems in 6 of 7 tests
feed.sum: The simple baseline was also 5.1x faster than the next system.
